title: Smart Study: AI Exam Planner
description:
Ace Your Board Exams with Smart Study – The AI Exam Planner for Students 🎓

Smart Study is a powerful AI Study Planner, CBSE Planner, and Exam Countdown Planner designed for school and college students in India.

Struggling with exam stress, syllabus overload, or poor time management? This smart study timetable app helps you plan smarter, revise faster, and score better.
Perfect for:
• CBSE students
• ICSE students
• State board students
• JEE, NEET, SAT aspirants
• College students

📅 Smart Study Timetable App

Create a personalized study timetable in seconds.
Plan subjects, track daily study hours, and manage homework easily.

⏳ Exam Countdown Planner

Set your exam dates and track exactly how many days are left.
Stay motivated with visual progress tracking.

📚 Syllabus Tracker for Board Exams

Track your syllabus chapter by chapter.
See what percentage is complete before your exam.
📝 Homework Planner for Students

Add assignments with deadlines.
Get smart reminders so you never miss submission.

🍅 Pomodoro Focus Timer

Boost concentration using the built-in study timer.
Track daily focus hours and build strong study habits.

☁️ 1 GB Secure Academic Portfolio (Premium)

Store marksheets, certificates, and achievements safely in the cloud.
Access your academic documents anytime, anywhere.
🤖 AI Study Assistant (Premium)

Ask unlimited questions.
Get instant summaries, explanations, and revision help from your AI tutor.

🏆 Gamified Study System

Earn badges and rewards for completing tasks.
Turn studying into a motivating habit.
Why Students Love Smart Study:

• All-in-one student planner app
• Designed for Indian board exam students
• Clean and distraction-free interface
• Secure cloud backup and sync

If you are looking for a CBSE planner, board exam planner, or smart study timetable app in India, Smart Study is your perfect academic companion.

Download now and start planning smarter today 🚀
